mainEntity.name: How do I follow a reading plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Plan pane offers the whole Bible in a year, the New Testament in 90 days, the Gospels in 40 and the Psalms in 30. Tick a chapter when it is read; reading ahead or catching up needs no bookkeeping.

The Plan pane counts the days in a row with reading, the chapters of the last seven days and how much of the Bible has been read. A chapter counts after half a minute on screen, or when ticked in a plan.

mainEntity.name: Where is the verse of the day?

acceptedAnswer.text: At the top of the Plan pane, with a way back to where reading stopped.
